name: JobAdder
summary: JobAdder shows no prices. Its four Recruiter plans, Lite, Essential, Pro and Business, each lead to a Request pricing form, and add-ons are priced separately. The FAQ says annual contracts are standard, paid either monthly or yearly.

facts.text: The recruitment CRM page says recruiters can group candidates into their own pools and share them with a colleague or the whole team.
The outreach page describes automated email sequences and campaigns for candidate aftercare, business development and client check-ins, with each step sent on schedule.
The CRM page advertises multi-posting to 130+ job boards, 180+ integration partners, and candidate profiles that can include third-party data from SEEK and LinkedIn.

plans.name: Recruiter Lite
plans.notes: Core ATS and CRM, multi-posting, careers page and basic reports. The page does not say whether pricing is per user.

plans.name: Recruiter Essential
plans.notes: Adds Adder Intelligence, automations, analytics and KPIs.

plans.name: Recruiter Pro
plans.notes: Adds advanced analytics, Smart Forms and a sandbox.

hiddenCosts: Add-ons such as Analytics, Roi-AI and Broadbean are priced separately and are quote-only.
The page offers a demo and no free trial, and it names no currency or region for pricing.
